summary: Edenor filed a Form 6-K disclosing its decision to participate in a competitive sale process for Metrogas S.A., Argentina's main gas distribution company. On July 23, 2026, Edenor and Andina PLC submitted a binding offer to YPF S.A. to acquire 70% of Metrogas's share capital and voting rights, plus 5% of MetroEnergia S.A., a Metrogas subsidiary. No price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. The acquisition would diversify Edenor into natural gas distribution, pending acceptance and consummation. There is no assurance of deal completion; the risk-arb angle centers on regulatory approvals and YPF's selection among bidders.
